_comment: Plan-document discipline. Read by scripts/loop/plan-doc.ts; every field can be
overridden per run with HARNESS_PLAN_DIR / HARNESS_EVIDENCE_DIR /
gate.mode  risk   (default) a card declaring Risk: medium|high needs an approved plan
off    none do — interactive runs only; an unattended loop refuses to honour it
evidence.requireAtRisk  the risk floor at which evidence/<date>-<card>/ must be filled
before a card ships. 'off' disables it. Cards compiled from a
plan document always carry evidence, whatever this says.
waves.maxParallel       how many cards of one dependency wave may run at once;
also the default worker count for `swarm.ts start`
